discipline: The 30 theorem checks are NOT proofs (proofs are analytic, in the two theorem modules). The 19 non-theorem checks are CLASSIFICATIONS with explicit witnesses / falsification specs, NOT proofs that the statements are true. NO measured value is a theorem. NO TRAINING, NO GRADIENTS, NO GPU, NO NEW EXPERIMENT DATA.
honest_note: 49 statements cannot all be new non-trivial theorems: 8 are demonstrably false, 5 were formally withdrawn, 3 are unproved conjectures, 3 are empirical claims no theorem can establish. Promoting them would be exactly the theorem inflation / 'numerical verification as proof' the review warned against.
